evidence.excerpt: Official Balos menus page identifies current Mothers Day, Sunset Prix Fixe, Brunch, Lunch, Dinner, Dessert, and For Five Coffee surfaces; alcohol-only sections are excluded.
Current dinner page enumerates crudo, raw bar, caviar, salads/soup, whole fish, land, sea, sides, and dessert items.
Current lunch page enumerates Power Lunch, salads, soup, whole fish, and seafood items.
Current brunch page enumerates prix fixe starters, mains, desserts, and For Five Coffee.
Official dessert service page; dessert details are current restaurant-issued content.
Official site identifies Balos Estiatorio in Washington, DC and links menu/service surfaces.
Independent location listing corroborates Balos Estiatorio at 1940 N St NW, Washington, DC 20036.
